column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C). Butter and flour three 6-inch cake pans.
Sift the flour, salt and baking soda together in a medium bowl.
Cream the butter on medium, add the sugar and beat about 3 minutes until fluffy. Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Sift in the cocoa powder and mix just until combined; scrape the bowl.
Stir the buttermilk, vinegar and food coloring together in a measuring cup.
On low speed, add half the flour mixture then half the buttermilk mixture; repeat, mixing only until combined.
Divide the batter among the pans and bake 30–35 minutes until the centers spring back.
Cool in the pans 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool completely.
For the frosting, beat the cream cheese and butter on medium about 3 minutes until smooth, then mix in the vanilla and salt.
On low, gradually add the sifted powdered sugar, then beat on medium about 1 minute until fluffy. Reserve about 1 cup for piping.
Stack the layers with about 1/2 cup frosting between each, then frost the top and sides and smooth with a scraper.
Pipe a decorative border with the reserved frosting and chill about 1 hour until set.
